data.long_meaning: The name Rozella is derived from the Latin word 'rosa', which means rose. This beautiful and delicate flower symbolizes love, passion, and new beginnings. In Christian tradition, the rose represents the Virgin Mary and her divine motherhood.

The Virgin Mary, also known as the 'Mother of Roses', is revered by Catholics for her unwavering faith, love, and devotion to God. Rozella, as a symbolic representation of the rose, serves as a worthy tribute to Mary and inspires the bearer to embody the virtues that she embodies.
